CREATE TABLE local_client_connections (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	installation_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	client_instance_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_local_client_state CHECK (state IN ('active','stopped')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(installation_id) REFERENCES installation_identities (installation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_local_client_installation UNIQUE (installation_id, client_instance_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_local_client_generation CHECK (generation >= 0)
)
ALTER TABLE auth_sessions RENAME TO auth_sessions_v39

CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
	token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	auth_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	local_client_id VARCHAR(64), 
	local_client_generation INTEGER CONSTRAINT ck_auth_sessions_local_generation CHECK ((local_client_id IS NULL AND local_client_generation IS NULL) OR (local_client_id IS NOT NULL AND local_client_generation IS NOT NULL AND local_client_generation >= 0)), 
	PRIMARY KEY (token_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(local_client_id) REFERENCES local_client_connections (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
INSERT INTO auth_sessions (token_hash,user_id,auth_method,created_at,expires_at) SELECT token_hash,user_id,auth_method,created_at,expires_at FROM auth_sessions_v39
